insight:
Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 3,819 steps and 2,343 kcal burned, which actually sits right at your 2,300 target. That's a decent baseline burn for a rest day. Sleep at 5.7 hours is the one number that stands out as a concern — that's not enough recovery for a body doing serious half marathon prep.

Your HRV at 98ms is just below your 99-118ms baseline, and combined with the short sleep, your body is telling you it hasn't fully recharged. Nothing alarming, but don't push intensity today. A steady easy run or light movement is the call — save the harder effort for when those numbers bounce back.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything. Aim for 7.5-8 hours — it's your cheapest performance tool. Hit your 175g protein today too, since overnight muscle repair depends on both adequate sleep *and* protein availability working together.
